title: Godot viewport.cpp crash in the wild.
body:
### Tested versions

This happens with Godot 4.5.1 on iOS in an app in the wild, we do not have steps to reproduce, but we are aware of 15 cases where this crash is being triggered

### System information

iOS 

### Issue description

The stack trace that we are getting is included below.

We believe we have a fix based on other similar fixes, will be sharing our patch shortly as a PR.
